name: AVEA Life AG
note: Swiss longevity-supplements startup in Zug; per its own about page, founded in 2021 by Duri Granziol, Sophie Chabloz, Teresa Budetta and Pascal Rode. Venture-built with and funded by Maximon, the Zug longevity company builder and its lead investor (seed funding totalling $5m, per longevity.technology 4 Jul 2023); Maximon's CHF 100m Longevity Co-Investment Fund, open to outside investors, also invested (startupticker.ch 7 Oct 2021). Current shareholders and any controlling owner are not publicly identified.
